title: How a change joins the shared work is the project's own convention
situation: The operator: the delivered workflow and the agents' values assumed one convention, GitHub flow with a branch and a pull request per task; what cratylus delivers is generic over a project's conventions.
decision: What cratylus delivers names no branching model and assumes no pull requests. A task hands over a change: what it changes, its tests and what was verified. How a change joins the project's shared work, the branching model, whether through a pull request, who joins it and when, is the project's own convention, which the lead follows. Under any convention a change joins only once every check passes and, under Ask, once its review approves it; where the operator has asked to review a change before it joins, only once the operator signs it off. The architect accepts the story on its outcome, and its rulings travel with the change they belong to.
consequences: Integration returns as a concept with this meaning; pull request leaves the design, its place taken by change; the gate, sign-off, operator, lead, builder, reviewer, task, handover, check, release, decision-rights, architect and concept-journal concepts state this. The delivered workflow, the agents' values and the assignment forms follow in the neutral-conventions story.
